# NHS

> The official NHS website for England providing comprehensive health information, service locators, and digital tools for accessing healthcare.

NHS.uk is the primary digital platform for England's National Health Service, offering patients access to health information, service directories, appointment booking, prescription management, and mental health support. The site integrates with NHS digital services including the NHS App, NHS 111 symptom checker, and NHS login for secure access to personal health records.

## Key Topics

- NHS App
- GP surgery
- NHS 111
- NHS number
- NHS login
- Prescriptions
- Mental health services
- Talking therapies
- Vaccinations
- Service locators
- GP appointments
- NHS e-Referral Service
- Self-referral
- Patient guides
- Health A to Z

## Core Services & Navigation

- [NHS website for England - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk): NHS homepage providing access to health info and services for England
- [Health A to Z - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/health-a-to-z): Comprehensive health directory covering conditions, symptoms, medicines and treatments
- [NHS services - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services): Overview of NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, hospitals and online services
- [Get help for your symptoms - NHS 111](https://111.nhs.uk): NHS 111 online symptom checker and triage service for urgent care

## Find & Access Healthcare Services

- [Find a GP - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/service-search/find-a-GP): Locate GPs near you with opening times, services and performance ratings
- [Find a pharmacy - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/service-search/find-a-pharmacy): Locate nearby pharmacies with opening times and services in England
- [Find a dentist - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/service-search/find-a-dentist): Search for dentists by location with ratings, services and opening hours
- [Register with a GP surgery - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/how-to-register-with-a-gp-surgery): Guide to registering with a GP surgery or changing GP in England
- [Find your NHS number - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/find-nhs-number): Service to retrieve your NHS number by text, email or letter

## GP Appointments & Prescriptions

- [Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/gp-appointments-and-bookings): How to book, change and cancel GP appointments online and in-person
- [How to order a repeat prescription - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/prescriptions/how-to-order-a-repeat-prescription): Step-by-step guide to ordering repeat prescriptions via NHS App or GP
- [View your test results - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/view-your-test-results): Guide to viewing test results online through NHS App and GP health records

## Mental Health & Wellbeing

- [Mental health - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/mental-health): Mental health hub with support resources, therapies and self-help guides
- [Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/mental-health-services/find-nhs-talking-therapies-for-anxiety-and-depression): Self-referral guide to NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression
- [Healthy living - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/live-well): NHS guidance on healthy living, diet, exercise, smoking and weight management

## Vaccinations & Preventive Care

- [Vaccinations - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/vaccinations): NHS vaccination information for babies, children and adults with booking
- [Winter vaccinations and winter health - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/live-well/seasonal-health/keep-warm-keep-well): Winter health advice including flu and COVID-19 vaccination eligibility

## Specialized Support & Referrals

- [Social care and support guide - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/social-care-and-support): Guide to social care and support options for illness, disability and care needs
- [Get NHS help for back or joint problems from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/get-nhs-help-for-back-joint-problems): Self-referral guide to NHS physiotherapy and musculoskeletal services
- [Colds, coughs and ear infections in children - NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/baby/health/colds-coughs-and-ear-infections-in-children): Guide to treating colds, coughs and ear infections in children under 5
